question: Why is the sparśa consonant series identified with the domain of the knowable?
premises: The knowable domain extends up to the twenty-fifth element.
The sparśa consonants are twenty-five in number.
What is knowable is characterized by clear manifestation.
inference: The twenty-five sparśa consonants correspond to the fully manifest domain of the knowable.
uncertainties: The correspondence with the twenty-five tattvas is implied rather than stated explicitly.
plain_english: Because this knowable domain, extending to the twenty-fifth, is clearly manifest, this much is declared to have the form of the sparśa consonants.
